title: Two Sum
contract: Return the two indices whose values sum to target, or [-1,-1]. Return the first pair discovered by increasing right index; never reuse an index.
reasoning: Enumerate earlier indices for each right index so the baseline has a precise tie rule.
Only earlier values belong in the map. Looking up before inserting prevents pairing a value with itself.
A successful complement is sufficient because need + current = target. Widen arithmetic to long before subtraction.
